interpretation: The adaptive hybrid constitutive representation passes all preregistered Stage-A solver-response gates.
The result is reproduced at O0 and O2.
In this fixture the adaptive representation is materially closer to the analytical Richards result than both fixed-50 and fixed-100 baselines for head, water content and bottom flux.
The adaptive candidate changes the nonlinear path slightly: five iterations/backtracks versus four for analytical.
This is fidelity evidence, not yet an end-to-end speedup claim, because the Stage-A research provider deliberately still evaluates the analytical provider before overwriting lookup-domain values.
next_gate: F-AHL04B fast-provider implementation and timing: remove redundant analytical evaluation inside the lookup domain, account for build cost, and compare total Richards CPU plus diagnostics against analytical, fixed-50 and fixed-100 across a broader material/case set.
